title: Run first synthetic browser UX round against the fixture founder journey
body:
## Outcome
Produce reproducible observations that identify the next highest-impact design changes.
## Delivery
Status: Closed (Nissan, 8 November 2026) — the first round was completed with **partial outcomes**, not all passes. The report and evidence were merged in #48 (`2bcf5d8`, including #43's preflight); product changes from its findings were merged in #47 (`9ae3e03`). Remaining work is linked below.
Previous status (superseded 8 November 2026): Blocked — draft PR #43 preserves the original Codex preflight. [Loki's published continuation](https://sacred-koan-dbt6.here.now/) reports 36/36 scripted browser checks and one partial T13 actor attempt at `d3f54e8`; zero completed variants. Codex has reviewed the published actor/verifier reports and six selected screenshots, supporting the bounded partial result; the report/screenshot access blocker is resolved. Original raw traces/manifest and machine-readable test outputs are not linked for this session's audit. Fictional source navigation/return/closure setup, #41/#42 fixture gaps and #9 actual zoom remain outstanding. [Published-evidence assessment](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/pull/43#issuecomment-6695504404).
Priority: P0
Iteration: Next / stretch for 01 (#23)
Role: Codex facilitator, run `ux26-20261106`, branch `research/26-first-browser-round`; fresh isolated actors and a separate verifier. Accountable coordinator: Nissan.
Dependencies: #25, with pinned build/URL, verified task capabilities and fixture reset instructions.
## Acceptance
- Facilitator checks capability registry and runbook before selection. Start with P1/T01, P2/T03, P3/T05, UX7/T13–T14 and supported UX8/T15 variants; unsupported tasks remain not run/blocked with reasons. T04 waits for comparison/export.
- Actors receive only assigned actor profile/task brief, starting URL and input constraints in a fresh context. Never provide facilitator mappings, expected outcomes or previous review discussion; disclose any priming.
- Record model/version, role/run ID, commit/build, browser/viewport/theme, fixture/clock, actual actions, screenshots and observable results; separate observations from hypothetical reactions.
- Keep visible UI evidence distinct from full scenario/backend passes. Synthetic sessions establish no human comprehension, accessibility conformance or live answer correctness.
- Create deduplicated GitHub findings with severity, reproduction, persona/task/variant, evidence and acceptance for retest. Summarise actual attempts, blocks and limitations; no invented completion rate.
- Readiness and report review by a separate verifier; preserve the original run evidence before fixes.
## Exclusions
No real user study or held-out Ragas evaluation. No ingestion of persona tests or expected outcomes into the retrieval corpus.

## Zoom readiness follow-up from PR #39

On 6 November 2026 Nissan [approved deferring actual 200% browser zoom](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/pull/39#issuecomment-6682937495) from #39's pre-merge acceptance to #9. The facilitator must link #9's pinned-build verification evidence before treating T14's actual-zoom variant as supported/verified. Until available, record that variant as unverified/blocked with a reason; viewport resizing is not actual browser zoom. Other supported variants retain their own readiness checks. No actor sessions or accessibility results are implied, and this update does not dispatch work or remove the #25 build/preflight dependency.


## Reconciliation against merged #47–#49 — 8 November 2026
By Claude (`claude-reconcile-20261108`) on Nissan's instruction. Verified on `main` at `0a7d9a6` from a fresh clone ([evidence](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/issues/23#issuecomment-6714202965); builder-run, not independent). Nothing was rebuilt.

| Acceptance | Outcome | Where it lives |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Capability and readiness check before selection; unsupported tasks recorded with reasons | Done: preflight at `d3f54e8` (`research/synthetic-ux/preflight/ux26-20261106/`) | #48 |
| Fresh isolated actors, no coaching, priming disclosed | Done: original T13 attempt and seven follow-up variants. Exploratory T01 and primed dark T14 are labelled as such (`followup/METHOD-NOTES.md`) | #48 |
| Full run records (model, run, build, browser, theme, fixture, actions, screenshots) | Done: traces and actor reports; 196 committed screenshots, hash-verified (`verify-evidence.py`) | #48 |
| UI evidence kept distinct from full passes; no human or accessibility claims | Done: "seven executed, NOT seven passes"; T03/T05 partial; T13 incomplete | #48 README |
| Deduplicated findings with severity, reproduction and retest acceptance | Done: continuity → #45; wording → #46; 19px phone overflow (fixed) | #45, #46, #27 |
| Separate verifier; original evidence preserved before fixes | Done: independent reviews in `original/` and `followup/`; original attempts kept unchanged | #48 |

**Not completed in this round, and where it belongs:**
- **T13** (source navigation, return and inline panel-close): no completed attempt. Moved to **#53**.
- **T03/T05 follow-up continuity:** **#45** (Codex, design in PR #51).
- **Requirement/preparation wording and terms:** delivered in #47. **#46** is ready to close.
- **Actual 200% zoom:** scoped evidence only (fresh light-theme T14 actor plus a primed dark check, on candidate builds). Everything else stays in **#9**.
- **Verifying the fixes at a new exact build, and the retrospective:** **#27**.
- **Real participants, screen readers, live sources:** out of scope for synthetic rounds.

The status "Blocked" above described the state before the 7 November follow-up and the #47/#48 merges. It is kept as history.
